title: Wiser Atlas: temporal knowledge graph v2 (extends wisegraph v1)
description: Files: nodes.json {_meta, nodes[]}, edges.json {_meta, edges[]}, streams.json {groups[], lanes[], links[]}. Ids reuse wisegraph v1 ids (people.json, traditions.json) so v1 consumers keep working. See SCHEMA.md.

fuzzyTime.description: A fuzzy date. Years are integers, negative = BCE, there is no year 0. start/end are the widest plausible bounds of the estimate, not a point.

end.description: null with open=true means ongoing (living person, active school)

basis.description: traditional = the tradition's own (often hagiographic) dating; scholarly = modern critical estimate where it differs from received history

label.description: display string, e.g. 'c. 950–1016', '6th c. BCE', '563–483 BCE (traditional)'

derived.description: on edges: how the time was inferred when not stated (e.g. 'overlap of lives')

check.description: work = the scholar's own publication; cited = a source named by the curator; mentioned = the cited article names the other end (machine check, not proof of the relation); unverified = a relevant article cited but the link was not found in it; needs_source = curator assertion only; reviewed = a human checked the claim against the source

match.description: the name variant found by the mention check

year.description: first publication year of this edition/translation

treats.description: node ids of the primary texts / figures the work edits, translates or studies

ids.description: openpatala / OpenAlex / Crossref ids when matched

id.description: lowercase-hyphen; v1 ids kept verbatim; new non-person kinds use prefixes c- p- pl- d- ev-

stream.description: primary swimlane (streams.json lanes[].id); concepts may have none

time.description: life for persons, composition for texts, floruit/activity for schools, date for events

time_alt.description: competing datings, e.g. traditional vs scholarly

tradition.description: the most specific wisegraph v1 traditions.json id this node belongs to (v1 compatibility)

legacy.description: {table: people|traditions, id, kind} when the node exists in wisegraph v1

talks.description: computed from app/clips.json: by (speaker), about (figures[]), topics

lineage.description: name of the transmission line for teacher_of / initiated (e.g. 'kagyu', 'trika-line', 'thai-forest')

basis.description: traditional = asserted by the tradition (hagiographic lineage, revelation, attributed authorship)

work.description: id of the scholar work this edge comes from

legacy_type.description: how the edge projects into wisegraph v1 edges.json
